context: Supplement specified after main typed nonlinear controls passed acquisition and pressure displayed a ceiling, before any dense calibration outcome. Original model selection/protocol retained unchanged.
purpose: Check whether the shared state/replay evaluator detects interference in one non-ceiling reference configuration; not a trained Titans, sleep or Hebbian method result.

representation.key_code: CPU Torch seed90401 Gaussian rows normalized to unit length
representation.note: Both representation geometry and fast-matrix size differ from orthogonal control; do not attribute their between-control difference to one factor.

rule: Linear half-sum-SSE gradient write with step1: W+=k outer(v-kW). Initial W zero, no decay, no offline training. Read query key only and first16 output coordinates.

evaluation.suite: Frozen shared full evaluator and unchanged closed-vocabulary streams/schedules
evaluation.eligibility: acquire2/revise2 allcorrect>=.9, acquire4 allcorrect>=.8, and K8D0 fixed four-target allcorrect>=.8
evaluation.secondary: Per-K D0 acquisition, per-stratum delay curves, repeat control, boundary reset, FIFO residency, write counts and state bytes
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 paired whole-episode resamples,seed90404; one fixed codebook, no codebook-seed population inference

selection: One fixed configuration, no key-code/step/dimension search. A weakD0cell remains acquisition/interference diagnostic rather than retention.
handoff: Keep this calibration separate from the admitted nonlinear checkpoints; it exercises the same plugin/state contract for future sleep and Hebbian adapters.
